SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.B. REGISTRY
Date May 29, 1942. 11437-8/5
30 5 /42

(Special Branch) Office Notes

Sir,

Pao Chia Reports re Births & Deaths

With reference to attached memo on this subject
from the Commissioner of the Public Health Dep't, forms
are being prepared for the recording of vital statistics
by the Pao Chia Guidance Office and copies will later be
sent weekly to the Public Health Dep't as requested.

（印：FILE）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER 42）

D.C. (Crime & Special Branches).

Officer i/c Chinese Affairs,
Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务科登记室
日期：1942年5月29日。编号 11437-8/5
30 5 /42

（特务科）办公备忘录

敬启者，

关于保甲报告出生及死亡事项

兹就公共卫生局局长就此主题所附备忘录而言，保甲指导办公室正在编制用于记录 Vital Statistics（生命统计）的表格，并将按请求，随后每周向公共卫生局发送副本。

（印：归档）

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长 42）

D.C.（刑事科与特务科）。

华务警官，
特务科。

REF.11

Memorandum.

PUBLIC HEALTH DEPARTMENT,
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL.
Shanghai, May 12th, 1942.

To Commissioner of Police.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COMMISSIONER 13 MAY 1942）

"Pao Chia" Force
Reports re Births & Deaths

I have been informed that under the "Pao Chia" organi-
sation, reports re Births & Deaths are required, and these are
forwarded to the various police stations.
As this information is of vital interest to this
Department I should be obliged if copies of such reports could
be forwarded to me weekly, in order to supplement our vital
statistics records.

（批注框内容：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / O/C L. B / 13.5.42.）

Jn Jm [签名]
Commissioner of Public Health.

HCL

12514
备忘录。

工部局公共卫生局，
上海，1942年5月12日。

致警务处处长。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长 1942年5月13日）

“保甲”队伍
关于出生及死亡的报告

本人获悉，根据“保甲”组织的规定，需提交关于出生及死亡的报告，并将这些报告送至各警察分局。
由于此类信息对本局至关重要，如能将此类报告的副本每周转发给本人，以补充本局的生命统计记录，本人将不胜感激。

（批注框内容：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 兰路分区主管 / 1942年5月13日。）

Jn Jm [签名]
公共卫生局局长。

HCL
